messages.content: 你好，我是 Betterboxd，你的观影数据助手。我可以帮你记录和查询观影历史、统计类型与导演偏好、讨论刚看的片子，或者管理想看的清单。想从哪开始？比如「记一笔新看的电影」、「统计今年偏好」，或者「聊聊我最近看的片」。
统计一下我最喜欢的导演 Top 5，平均分和观看次数加权计算

{"saved_queries":[{"id":"01a06bbd-d787-7990-a81f-1c7d96a78970","name":"各月平均分排行","sql":"SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', watched_date) AS 月份, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS 平均分, COUNT(*) AS 记录数 FROM v_diary_full WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 平均分 DESC LIMIT 12","last_run_at":1788513998},{"id":"01a06bbf-03a0-73e1-9bf7-2c472b9e9f52","name":"最长观影间隔","sql":"SELECT watched_date AS 日期, title_zh AS 片名, CAST(julianday(watched_date) - julianday(LAG(watched_date) OVER (ORDER BY watched_date)) AS INTEGER) AS 间隔天数 FROM v_diary_full WHERE watched_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 间隔天数 DESC LIMIT 10","last_run_at":1788514075}]}

我先查一下有没有已保存的同类型统计，再给你算。

已存的统计项目里没有「导演 Top5」这类，我直接按导演聚合写一条新 SQL 来算：把每部观影记录的 directors 展开，统计每个导演的**平均分**与**观看次数**，并用次数做对数权重给出加权分。

function.name: run_stats
function.arguments:
{"sql": "SELECT je.value AS 导演,
  COUNT(*) AS 观看次数,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating), 1) AS 平均分,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating) * LOG(COUNT(*) + 1), 1) AS 加权分
FROM v_diary_full v, json_each(v.directors) je
WHERE v.rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY je.value
ORDER BY 加权分 DESC
LIMIT 5", "chart": {"type": "bar", "title": "我的导演 Top5（平均分×次数加权）"}}

messages.content:
{"error":"sqlite: no such function: LOG in SELECT * FROM (SELECT je.value AS 导演,
  COUNT(*) AS 观看次数,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating), 1) AS 平均分,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating) * LOG(COUNT(*) + 1), 1) AS 加权分
FROM v_diary_full v, json_each(v.directors) je
WHERE v.rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY je.value
ORDER BY 加权分 DESC
LIMIT 5) LIMIT 1000 at offset 134"}
LOG 函数在这版 SQLite 里不可用，我换成 LN（自然对数）重算：

function.name: run_stats
function.arguments:
{"chart": {"title": "我的导演 Top5（平均分×次数加权）", "type": "bar"}, "sql": "SELECT je.value AS 导演,
  COUNT(*) AS 观看次数,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating), 1) AS 平均分,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating) * LN(COUNT(*) + 1), 1) AS 加权分
FROM v_diary_full v, json_each(v.directors) je
WHERE v.rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY je.value
ORDER BY 加权分 DESC
LIMIT 5"}

messages.content:
{"error":"sqlite: no such function: LN in SELECT * FROM (SELECT je.value AS 导演,
  COUNT(*) AS 观看次数,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating), 1) AS 平均分,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating) * LN(COUNT(*) + 1), 1) AS 加权分
FROM v_diary_full v, json_each(v.directors) je
WHERE v.rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY je.value
ORDER BY 加权分 DESC
LIMIT 5) LIMIT 1000 at offset 134"}

两个对数函数都没有。我换成不依赖对数函数的加权公式：用「平均分 ÷ 观看次数的平方根衰减」或直接用「平均分 × (观看次数 / 最多次数)」这种归一化权重。考虑到你想体现「次数多且分高」的导演，我用一个简洁的公式：**加权分 = 平均分 × (观看次数 / 最高观看次数)**，这样既保留次数影响，又不需要特殊函数。

不过更直观的做法是直接同时给出「平均分」和「次数」，然后按平均值排序，因为观看次数本身已经在计数里体现了。我改成下面这条：

function.name: run_stats
function.arguments:
{"chart": {"title": "我的导演 Top5（按平均分×次数加权）", "type": "bar"}, "sql": "SELECT je.value AS 导演,
  COUNT(*) AS 观看次数,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating), 1) AS 平均分,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating) * COUNT(*) / (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM v_diary_full v2, json_each(v2.directors) je2 WHERE v2.rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY je2.value)), 1) AS 加权分
FROM v_diary_full v, json_each(v.directors) je
WHERE v.rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY je.value
ORDER BY 加权分 DESC
LIMIT 5"}

改一下公式，使用 (导演平均分+5*整体平均分)/(观看该导演电影数+5)
改用贝叶斯平滑公式（类似 IMDb 加权）：**加权分 = (导演平均分 + 5×整体平均分) ÷ (该导演观看数 + 5)**。整体平均分取我所有有分记录的平均值。

function.name: run_stats
function.arguments:
{"chart": {"title": "我的导演 Top5（贝叶斯平滑加权）", "type": "bar"}, "sql": "SELECT je.value AS 导演,
  COUNT(*) AS 观看次数,
  ROUND(AVG(v.rating), 1) AS 平均分,
  ROUND((AVG(v.rating) + 5 * (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM v_diary_full WHERE rating IS NOT NULL)) / (COUNT(*) + 5), 1) AS 加权分
FROM v_diary_full v, json_each(v.directors) je
WHERE v.rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY je.value
ORDER BY 加权分 DESC
LIMIT 5"}

从结果看，你目前**还没有任何一位导演看满 5 部**，所以平滑权重全部向整体均值压缩，区分度偏低。要不要我换个口径，比如**看满 2 部以上的导演**再做加权，更能看出你的真实偏好？或者把这条存为统计项目？

function.name: run_stats
function.arguments:
{"chart": {"title": "Solanas 加权分", "type": "table"}, "sql": "SELECT je.value AS 导演,
